newsitem.title: USA: ENI files for up to 4.09 mln ordinary shares.
newsitem.headline: ENI files for up to 4.09 mln ordinary shares.

text.p: ENI SpA filed Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a registration statement for an offering of an estimated 4.09 million ordinary shares by the Italian Treasury.

The securities being registered include American Deepositary Shares to be sold in the U.S., shares to be sold outside the U.S. and shares covering over-allotment options to U.S. and international underwriters.

For registration purposes, ENI estimated the value of the offering at $200 million, based on the the high and low sale price of the ADSs on the New York Stock Exchange of $48.88 on September 16, according to the filing.
Each ADS represents 10 ordinary shares, the filing said.
CS First Boston and Istituto Mobiliare Italiano are the joint global coordinators of the offering.
ENI will not receive any proceeds from the offering.
